admission.justification: Checking immutable launch scope before resume prevents an old agent resuming into a different current enclosure.

applicability: Revive of leaf-bound worker, reviewer or curator.
exclusions: Taskless and sprint/master contexts follow their separate rules.
statement: For a leaf-bound role Revive first compares the task reference and contract path the launch recorded in the receipt (`arMcpContext.taskContext`) with the pair computed now from the leaf document alone, and refuses with both values when they differ or when none was recorded; the comparison creates and starts nothing and no bridge call is made.
